description: Fail-fast launch contract for the Revo3 single-hand T-Rex adaptation. This is a Revo-specific cascaded stage-2 run, not a claim that the released T-Rex paper midtrain corpus or protocol was reproduced.
limitations: Execution requires an independently approved real-robot dataset readiness manifest; synthetic fixtures are rejected.
The VLA dataset and model contract contain RGB, language, Revo3 state/action, and tactile features only. EMG remains outside T-Rex.

The current main-branch LeRobot converter is upstream-bimanual (62-D); this launcher accepts the reviewed Revo3 JSON contract only until a dedicated 21-D LeRobot converter passes replay and schema gates.
The official 10-finger VQ-VAE and deformation encoder are not silently reused for the five-finger Revo3 sensor; continuous calibrated 5x6 tactile features are used.

The raw released midtrain checkpoint is rejected even in ablation mode. The ablation becomes launchable only after a separately verified Revo3 migration artifact removes the 10-finger embedded VQ path and records all reinitialized shape-mismatched heads.
FLARE is disabled until Revo3 future-frame lookup and timing have a real-data verification artifact.
